about: The Azimuth builds the shim's byte signatures were checked against (azimuth.exe's SHA-256), and the newest one. ops/release-prod.sh puts them into the server's launcher config as latestAzimuth and supportedAzimuth (fh2mp-release compat). Was AZIMUTH_VERSION and BUILTIN_AZIMUTH_BUILDS in launcher/fh2mp_launcher/constants.py up to 1.4.8.
